intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer {{course}} in the Ahmedabad region. This page compares recorded fees and placements from our database opened in {{year}}.

Ganpat University vs Nirma University for MCA is a private comparison. Nirma has the higher recorded year tuition and a 2022 placement year. Ganpat has a later recorded year, from 2024, with a higher highest package on this page.

sections.heading: Ganpat University vs Nirma University for MCA: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Nirma University if you want a well-known university campus and a recorded 2022 average of ₹5 lakh, with a highest of ₹14 lakh, and can budget recorded tuition of ₹1.49 lakh a year.
Choose Ganpat University if the later 2024 record matters, at an average of ₹4 lakh and a highest of ₹20 lakh, and recorded tuition of ₹1 lakh a year.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show
paragraphs: Ganpat University has recorded MCA tuition of ₹1 lakh a year. Treat this as a recorded year fee, not a confirmed two-year or three-year total, until you check the official circular.
Nirma University has recorded tuition of ₹1.49 lakh a year. Confirm both official notices for the current admission year and programme duration.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Ganpat University's recorded 2024 figures are an average package of ₹4 lakh and a highest package of ₹20 lakh. These are historical outcomes, not a salary promise.
Nirma's latest recorded year here is 2022, with an average of ₹5 lakh and a highest of ₹14 lakh. The years are not the same, so do not read them as a same-batch comparison.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Neither side has an entrance exam listed in our records on this page. MCA admissions in Gujarat may use a state or university test, or bachelor's marks in a relevant subject.
Read the current official admissions page of each university for eligibility and duration.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Nirma University is on the Sarkhej-Gandhinagar highway in Ahmedabad. Ganpat University's main campus is at Kherva, in Mehsana district.
Visit the teaching campus you will join. The commute is not the same.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you want the later placement year and a lower recorded year tuition, Ganpat University is the side with 2024 figures and ₹1 lakh tuition on this page.
If you want Nirma's campus and a 2022 average of ₹5 lakh, budget from the official ₹1.49 lakh year fee after you confirm the circular.
Do not compare 2022 and 2024 packages as if they described one graduating class.

faqs.answer: Ganpat has the later recorded year, 2024, with a ₹4 lakh average and a ₹20 lakh highest package, and recorded tuition of ₹1 lakh a year. Nirma has recorded tuition of ₹1.49 lakh and 2022 figures of a ₹5 lakh average and a ₹14 lakh highest package.

faqs.question: What are the recorded MCA fees?
faqs.answer: Our records list ₹1 lakh a year for Ganpat University and ₹1.49 lakh a year for Nirma University. These are year figures, not confirmed programme totals.

faqs.question: Do these universities have an entrance exam for MCA?
faqs.answer: No exam is listed for either side in our records on this page. Check each official admissions page.

faqs.question: How do placements compare?
faqs.answer: Ganpat's recorded 2024 average is ₹4 lakh and the highest is ₹20 lakh. Nirma's recorded 2022 average is ₹5 lakh and the highest is ₹14 lakh. The years are different.

faqs.question: Are Ganpat University and Nirma University in the same city?
faqs.answer: Nirma is in Ahmedabad. Ganpat University's main campus is at Kherva, Mehsana district. Confirm the teaching campus you will attend.
